w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Redactor is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The night shift is out: Old Gavel and Big-Eyes. They own the dark — the cast turns over after sunset, and every step is riskier. A lit fire is a beacon — light through canvas, smoke on the wind. Sealed and dark, you're just a smell in the night. Haven's walls end every argument.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 📨 The village didn't wait for you. Ingrid Vik was vouched for around the fire — they're walking.
Accepted. Ingrid Vik is walking. They'll reach Haven in a few days — membership starts when they arrive, but the village already counts them.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
A cold snap. Breath smokes. The woods go quiet.
⚠ WARNING: reserves critical. Eat tomorrow or the spiral begins.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (14/9/6), with 7 wave-4 fought, 8 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 5 · Forage 12 · Craft 8 · Talk 16 · Explore 29 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; promises kept. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE BELOVED — "Speak for the quiet ones."
◈ THE ARCHITECT — Sofia Chen ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

firenarr.line: ⚠ The store has fallen far from its recent high again — the shelves are nearly bare.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,276 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.
